acceptance: the release is calibrated and every gate passes: on each workload the case-mean PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS gates and the case-mean VBench drop from the case-mean BF16 reading, and on every case the looser per-case floors plus wall_seconds <= the workload's stage_seconds; otherwise valid=false and score 0. An uncalibrated release runs every case and records every reading but returns valid=false (uncalibrated_release). The quality-weighted compression score ranks and is never an admission gate

reference.compression: unique CUDA-storage bytes reachable from each encoded payload (runtime/quant_videogen/payload.py) versus BF16 KV bytes, each counted per compression call over all layers of that call and summed over every call of the case (all 10 LongCat segments, every HY cache_vision forward); the candidate's bf16_kv_bytes must equal the release's frozen per-case value
reference.fidelity: metrics/compare_frames.py (PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS against the case golden) on the workload's fidelity window: LongCat frames [73, 93), the first continued segment; HY frames [29, 45), the first chunk generated from compressed KV
reference.goldens: pinned BF16 frames per case (SHA-256 in the release), generated by scripts/stage_eval_inputs.py with the Judge's own runner adapters
reference.latency: per case: candidate wall_seconds <= the workload's stage_seconds, the budget the controller enforces on that stage
reference.quality_term: score = sqrt(R_longcat * (1 + q_longcat) * R_hy * (1 + q_hy)); q = 0.5 f + 0.5 v from the workload's case means, 0 for the official Quant-VideoGen codec (its case means on the 17 hidden cases, measured on each supported device class and frozen with that class's Judge data as models.<workload>.quality_reference): f = mean of the PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS gains from that codec toward 40 dB / 1 / 0, each capped at 1; v = min over the four VBench dimensions of 1 - max(BF16 - reading, 0) / mean-gate allowed drop, minus the same minimum for that codec
reference.vbench: metrics/run_vbench.py (four pinned dimensions) on every frame of each case, gated as the drop from the case's BF16 reading
